description.en: The ID of the customer gateway.

description.zh: 分页查询时每页显示的条目数。默认值：**10**，取值范围：**1**~**50**。
description.en: The number of entries per page for paging queries. Default value: **10**. Valid values: **1** to **50**.

description.zh:
IPsec连接所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the IPsec-VPN connection. 

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.

description.zh:
IPsec连接所属的资源组ID。

您可以调用[ListResourceGroups](~~158855~~)接口查询资源组ID。
description.en:
The ID of the resource group to which the IPsec-VPN connection belongs.

You can call the [ListResourceGroups](~~158855~~) operation to query the resource group ID.

description.zh:
IPsec连接绑定的标签列表。

一次最多支持输入20个标签。
description.en:
The list of tags bound to the IPsec-VPN connection.

You can specify up to 20 tags at a time.

description.zh:
标签键。一旦输入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。

一次最多支持输入20个标签键。
description.en:
The tag key. If you specify this parameter, the value cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

You can specify up to 20 tag keys at a time.

description.zh:
标签值。

标签值最多支持128个字符，可以为空字符串，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。

一个标签键对应一个标签值。一次最多支持输入20个标签值。
description.en:
The tag value.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and can be an empty string. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

Each tag key corresponds to one tag value. You can specify up to 20 tag values at a time.
The ID of the IPsec-VPN connection.
The instance ID of the VPN gateway.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc describe-vpn-connections --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpn-gateway-id vpn-bp1q8bgx4xnkx0000 --customer-gateway-id cgw-bp1mvj4g9kogw0000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --vpn-connection-id vco-bp10lz7aejumd0000 --tag Value=TagValue Key=TagKey --resource-group-id rg-acfmzs372yg0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun vpc DescribeVpnConnections --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key TagKey --CustomerGatewayId 'cgw-bp1mvj4g9kogw0000' --PageSize 10 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmzs372yg0000' --VpnGatewayId 'vpn-bp1q8bgx4xnkx0000' --PageNumber 1 --Tag.1.Value TagValue --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --VpnConnectionId 'vco-bp10lz7aejumd0000'
